reviews.text: Tara, John, Ciaran and all the team at IWDC have helped us so much with our rescue dog Ollie who struggles with dog reactivity and stranger danger, we now have the confidence in handling him. We have seen a massive improvement in his behaviour since attending regular obedience classes and as Ollie is a working dog he loves doing detection and tracking. He also goes to the kennels and is always looked after so well!

We recently used IWDC for 3 week residential training for our rescue puppy honey. We can't thank Tara enough for what she has done with honey she is much more content in herself her selective hearing is a bit more sporadic :)
Not only that we as owners feel more confident also the after caren has been elite only ever a text away . We would highly recommend IWDC 👌 we look forward to working with them even more

I first started bringing my dog to IWDC when he was showing reactivity in his doggy daycare and I also needed help with lead training because he was pulling so much. The staff at IWDC are incredibly knowledgeable and accommodating. Having understood what his challenges were, they helped my dog to settle in their kennels. I also sent him for a residential stint while we welcomed our first baby home, he was crate and lead trained while in the residential and it has made a huge difference to his behaviour at home. I can also run with my dog without him pulling, previously I had never imagined I'd be able to do that. :)

Tara and the crew have been phenomenal to deal with. We have two frenchies and learning what we need to do to help them more has been eye opening. Highly recommend them for training and boarding - the dogs love going in to see them!

Tara and john are absolutely fantastic very patient with our playful class clown of a lurcher sonny and both are a fountain of knowledge and everyday is a school day in what you learn and would highly recommend Iwdc if I could give more than 5 stars I would.
The best dog school and boarding kennels in Cork

IWDC are the best of the best. Our GSD, Bailey, benefited massively from the training programs. John, Tara and Ciaran have taught us so much as handlers. We thought we'd forever be in the pits. Bailey came to our wedding, was our ring bearer and so many friends & family could not get over her progress. It made our day having her there! That wasnt possible without the teams help and our consistency of putting learnings into action. Couldn't recommend IWDC more. Travelling from Kildare is worth every session. Choose here time and time again

I have been attending the IWDC for the last nine months and I could not imagine that the behavior change of my very challenging German shepherd and the dog handling skills provided has been transformational. Highly recommend this training facility and their professional instructors.
We cannot thank irish working dog college enough for the transformation of our dog. The positive training made a massive difference to my dogs confidence

We booked an assessment session for our puppy and paid €75 in advance. Unfortunately, the experience was very disappointing:

The eircode provided was incorrect, which caused us to arrive late and unable to find the place.

The phone number on their website does not work.

Communication via Messenger and WhatsApp was very slow, often taking days to get a response.

No cancellation or refund policy was provided before taking payment, but afterward they refused to refund or reschedule, even though the session was never delivered.

This left us out of pocket with no service provided. Very unprofessional and misleading setup — I would not recommend this business.

I cannot recommend Irish Working Dog College enough, we do Obedience classes, 121 Training Classes and Boarding with them and our Female Staffy loves it up there and all the staff. We have learned aa much ans our dog if not more. Its her little home away from home. Its such a piece of mind knowing our girl is so loved among the staff, and in the best care and hands and also looked after according to her breeds needs. Thank you all at Working Dog College

Very professional, one can always learn a lot more - even after a lifetime of having dogs. I highly recommend the service Irish Working Dog College provides. Especially if you get breeds that require special care. Boarding and Training, both excellent.

I have been working with Irish working dog college for years. They have expert knowledge on how to train any kind of dog and their facilities are top of the line! Currently have my 5 month old German Shepard learning the ropes from them

We have been bringing our very high energy springer Spaniel here for over 6 months. We originally brought him to help us with walking on the lead but between 121's, group obedience and detection classes we have come away with far more than what we thought we would, and also a mentally stimulated and much calmer dog every time. They have not only helped our dog but have also given us the knowledge to understand our dog's needs ourselves. We couldn't recommend Ciaran and the rest of the team enough.

I've been attending iwdc since June 2023 with my dog and still attend their weekly obedience classes, starting with puppy training and moving into high-level obedience. It has now become a great hobby for me, and I'm very grateful to the amazing trainers and the supportive environment at iwdc. Their expertise has not only helped me train my dogs effectively but has also improved my understanding of canine behavior. I highly recommend iwdc to anyone looking to enhance their training skills and build a stronger bond with their dogs! Plus, the community aspect makes it even more enjoyable.

Tara and John are a pleasure to deal with. They are gifted when it comes to training and understanding dogs and their advice has been invaluable. We have been to IWDC for both one on one training sessions and boarding kennels with our nervous,reactive dog and have watched him come on in leaps and bounds ever since. We have learned so much from them, their knowledge is exceptional. Our dog a absolutely loves going their . I could not recommend their services enough .

100% recommend!
